name: Sorry!

key_numbers.label: Goal
key_numbers.value: All 4 pawns HOME by exact count

setup.text: Put the board down and place the shuffled deck face down on 'Place Pack Here' as the draw pile.
Take the four pawns of one colour and put all four on your START. For a faster game put three on START and the fourth on the circle just below it.
Choose the first player. Play passes to the left and pawns move clockwise unless a card says otherwise.

turn.summary: Draw the top card, move as it says if you can, then discard it face up.
steps: Take the top card and carry out its move if you are able. A card is mandatory: if you can move, you must.
Only a 1 or a 2 takes a pawn out of START. A 1 puts it on the circle by your START and ends your turn. A 2 does the same or moves a pawn 2, then you draw again.

Cards: 3, 5, 8 and 12 move a pawn forward that many; 4 moves backward 4; 7 is one pawn forward 7 or split between two pawns; 10 is forward 10 or back 1; 11 is forward 11 or a switch with an opponent's pawn; SORRY! takes a pawn from START to an opponent's square and bumps it.
Landing on a square held by an opponent bumps that pawn back to its START. You may jump over pawns, counting each as one space.
If you cannot move, you forfeit the turn. If the draw pile runs out, reshuffle the discards.

end: The game ends when one player gets all four of their pawns HOME. If you play again, the winner goes first.

scoring.text: The standard game has no points. The first to bring all four pawns HOME wins.

missed.text: A pawn must reach HOME by exact count, and once HOME it never moves again.
Landing on the triangle at the start of a slide of another colour sends you to the end of the slide, bumping everything on it, including your own pawns. Your own colour's slide does nothing.
Only you can enter your own SAFETY ZONE. You cannot go forward past your zone entry square, but a backward move or a SORRY! or switch played on you can carry you past it.
A pawn moved back at least two spaces past your START can go straight into your SAFETY ZONE later, without circling the board.
You may not use a 7 to start a pawn. If part of a 7 takes a pawn HOME, you must be able to use the rest on another pawn.
The 11 only works on pawns on the open track, not those on START, HOME or a SAFETY ZONE. You may forfeit if you cannot move 11 and do not want to switch.
Two of your own pawns may never share a square. If your only move would do that, you forfeit.

not_covered: Adult 'play for points' variation with a five-card hand.
